title: Extend the venue template source registry
description: Keeps one generic template fetcher and adds ASME through the existing declarative source table and aliases.
changes: Add the CTAN asmeconf package as an allowlisted ASME template source.
Add ASME IDETC aliases without adding a venue-specific tool.
Keep primary-class validation and fail-closed behavior.

rollback.notes: Remove the ASME source and aliases while retaining the previous fetcher.
